This is a comic based on “The Incredibles”. It's also a spiritual sequel to a comic created years ago by another artist that was never finished.
Here is a link to the original if you wish to also read it. https://e-hentai.org/g/948505/ab0f35f86e/
The characters involved are Helen Parr and Violet Parr. It is a Futanari on Female work. However it also has a full story with character progression and honest development from the original work.
